reference_sql:
SELECT category_name, SUM(net_revenue_eur) / SUM(units) AS price_per_unit_eur
FROM sales
GROUP BY category_name
HAVING SUM(net_revenue_eur) / SUM(units) < 25
alternatives: SELECT category_name, SUM(net_revenue_eur) / SUM(units) AS price_per_unit_eur FROM sales GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(net_revenue_eur) < 25 * SUM(units)
